text: Kirin Holdings Company Limited assumed 100 per cent ownership of Lion Nathan in 2009; Lion Nathan is now Lion, the company behind Hahn.
short: Lion, the company behind Hahn, is wholly owned by Japan's Kirin Holdings.

source.name: Kirin Holdings News Release, 2009-09-17: Updated Process of Making Lion Nathan a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of Kirin Holdings Company
source.quote: Kirin has offered to acquire the remaining issued shares in Lion Nathan that it does not already own.
source.note: Kirin's own release, after Lion Nathan shareholders approved the scheme that made Lion Nathan a wholly-owned Kirin subsidiary on 21 October 2009 (the release states the scheduled implementation and delisting dates, with 98.75% of votes in favour).
